name: Title Tyranny (part 2)

date.source: The document's own dateline framing; only part two of this show is in this wing's own holdings.

notes: A 20-man battle royal simultaneously crowning the relaunched GIWF's own first National and World Heavyweight Champions -- the last man eliminated becomes National Champion, the last man remaining becomes World Champion.

matches.stipulation: 20-man battle royal, final two, deciding the GIWF National and World Heavyweight Championships
matches.note: Capitator eliminated Budden last with a Face Lift reverse chokeslam -- Budden, as last eliminated, is crowned National Champion; Capitator, as last man remaining, is crowned World Champion. Eighteen further entrants are not minted.

name: Primal Wars (part 1)

date.source: The document's own dateline framing; only part one of this show is in this wing's own holdings.

notes: A crossover card with the CAWF and NMIWF feds; CAWF's own champions (Scorpion, Revelations, Dr. D. Capitator, Flawless) are billed as visiting talent, their CAWF titles distinct from GIWF's own.

matches.note: Grifter won, clotheslining Equalizer over the top of the cage after both men fought to the top of it.

name: Last Bout

date.source: A full results bulletin for a live show, posted 17 November 1998.

notes: Closes on an unresolved angle: Scorpion superkicks Revelations from behind and lays a championship belt on him after a tag title change, without a clean pin or decision -- not recorded as a title change in this wing's own reigns.
